analysis.summary: Krishana Phoschem Limited reported Q1 FY27 revenue from operations of ₹532 crore, representing a 35% year-on-year growth, while EBITDA rose 36% to ₹89 crore. Despite early monsoon delays and geopolitical supply disruptions in West Asia, fertilizer demand recovered significantly in early July. Management expanded its NPK-DAP capacity to 495,000 MT and introduced several new complex fertilizer variants, supporting operating margins. Looking ahead, the company expects to achieve turnover growth of 30%-35% over last year and quarterly revenue exceeding ₹500 crore over the remaining quarters of FY27. Krishana Phoschem Limited commenced FY27 on a resilient note, with quarterly revenue growing 34.58% YoY to ₹532.3 crore and quarterly Profit After Tax increasing 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore.

guidance.claim: Management targets achieving an additional 30% to 35% turnover growth over the previous year.
guidance.quote: We are hoping that over the remaining quarters, we will be able to smoothen our production, and we will be able to achieve an additional 30%–35% turnover over last year.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve quarterly turnover exceeding ₹500 crore during the remaining three quarters of FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

guidance.claim: Management expects overall revenue growth of 35% to 40% in FY27.
guidance.quote: Yes, including the import and manufacturing we expect 40% growth should not be a big issue.

guidance.claim: The company expects a top-line increase of around Rs. 500 crore from the capacity expansion during the year.
guidance.quote: So, you can expect a top line increase of around Rs. 500 crore. So, this year we had around Rs. 2,400 odd crore. So, you expect an increase of around Rs. 500 crore more, Rs. 2,900 to Rs. 3,000.

demand_outlook.claim: Material improvement in rainfall during early July resulted in accelerated fertilizer offtake across key markets.
demand_outlook.quote: However, rainfall improved materially during early July, resulting in a rapid recovery in sowing progress, improved farmer sentiment, and accelerated fertilizer offtake across several key markets for the remainder of the Kharif season.

demand_outlook.claim: Fertilizer demand for the remainder of FY27 is expected to be supported by monsoon recovery, crop MSP hikes, and government NBS support.
demand_outlook.quote: Improving in monsoon conditions, higher MSP and continued government support through the Nutrient Based Subsidy (NBS) framework are expected to support the fertilizer demand during the remainder of FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: The phosphatic fertilizer sector is well-positioned for sustained growth, supported by strong demand fundamentals.
demand_outlook.quote: The phosphatic fertilizer sector is well-positioned for sustained growth, supported by strong demand fundamentals.

demand_outlook.claim: Improving monsoon conditions, higher MSP, and continued government backing through the NBS framework are creating a favorable operating environment.
demand_outlook.quote: Improving monsoon conditions, higher MSP & continued government backing through the Nutrient Based Subsidy (NBS) framework are creating a favourable operating environment.

demand_outlook.claim: The Kharif season demand environment appears constructive for the industry due to comfortable domestic stock levels and a favorable monsoon forecast.
demand_outlook.quote: With comfortable domestic stock levels & a favourable monsoon forecast, the Kharif season demand environment appears constructive for the industry.

demand_outlook.claim: The quarter ended March 2026 witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.
demand_outlook.quote: On the Rabi season, the quarter ended March ‘26, witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.

demand_outlook.claim: March saw a natural seasonal moderation in demand as key crops like wheat and mustard approached maturity.
demand_outlook.quote: March saw a natural seasonal moderation in demand as key crops such as wheat and mustard approached maturity consistent with typical fertilizer application cycles.

demand_outlook.claim: The industry concluded Q4 FY26 with comfortable inventory levels of 177 lakh metric tonne.
demand_outlook.quote: The industry concluded Q4 FY26 with comfortable inventory levels of 177 lakh metric tonne indicating balanced supply-demand conditions and healthy channel inventory levels.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects fertilizer demand to remain stable as water levels in reservoirs, rivers, and borewells are higher.
demand_outlook.quote: Therefore, we do not expect any stress on the agriculture sector, and consequently, fertilizer demand is expected to remain stable.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is currently evaluating capacity expansion opportunities that have not yet been approved by the Board.
capex_expansion.quote: We are currently evaluating certain capacity expansion opportunities. Since these have not yet been approved or disclosed through the statutory channels, we are not in a position to share details at this stage.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has an agreement to procure green ammonia from a third-party facility starting in FY29.
capex_expansion.quote: See this capacity of green ammonia is of a third-party capacity and we will buy this green ammonia with an arrangement from the Government of India, Department of Fertilizer one thing. And this capacity will start in FY29 after 2 years.

capex_expansion.claim: The company's expanded capacities at Meghnagar, including NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA, are now contributing progressively to performance.
capex_expansion.quote: Our expanded capacities at Meghnagar — NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA — are now contributing progressively to our performance.

capex_expansion.claim: NPK/DAP capacity was enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA, taking total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: NPK/DAP capacity enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA and existing SSP capacity at 120,000 MTPA, taking total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: Backward integration was strengthened with a sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: Backward integration strengthened with sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: The capacity expansion was funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans.
capex_expansion.quote: This expansion has been funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans, reflecting disciplined capital allocation.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 EBITDA stood at ₹89 crore, registering a 36% year-on-year growth.
margins_costs.quote: Quarterly EBITDA stood at ₹ 89 crore, reflecting a 36% year-on-year growth, supported by disciplined cost management, despite volatility in raw material prices.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins stand at approximately 7%–8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin is approximately 7%–8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.

margins_costs.claim: The company passed on approximately 25%–30% of increased raw material input costs via subsidies and MRP revisions.
margins_costs.quote: Overall, we have been able to pass on ~ 25%–30% of the increase in input costs.

margins_costs.claim: Sulphur prices increased from ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.
margins_costs.quote: Sulphur prices have risen from around ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.

margins_costs.claim: Quarterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore, reflecting improved operating efficiency and disciplined cost control.
margins_costs.quote: Quaterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore, reflecting improved operating efficiency and disciplined cost control.

margins_costs.claim: Global input costs tightened towards the latter part of the quarter due to supply-side constraints and higher freight costs.
margins_costs.quote: However, from mid-February onwards, global market witnessed firming trends driven by supply-side constraints, tightness in gas-linked production, higher logistic and freight costs.

margins_costs.claim: Ammonia and sulphur prices moved up sequentially during the quarter, creating a timing mismatch with domestic demand.
margins_costs.quote: As a result, ammonia prices moved up sequentially during the quarter. Sulphur prices also firmed up towards March. This created a timing mismatch where domestic demand was slowed down in March while input costs were increasing, leading to higher cost pressure in the closing quarter.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for the manufacturing side was around Rs. 5,500 per ton in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: It was in the range of Rs.5,500 per ton.

orders_capacity.claim: Total fertilizer production reached 89,747 metric tonnes in Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved fertilizer production of 89,747 metric tonnes, showcasing our consistent operational efficiency.

orders_capacity.claim: The NPK-DAP unit achieved 43% capacity utilization while the SSP unit achieved 121% utilization in Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: 43% capacity utilization of NPK-DAP unit and 121% capacity utilization of SSP unit, which was beyond the core.

orders_capacity.claim: The company added 165,000 MT of NPK-DAP capacity, taking total NPK-DAP capacity to 495,000 MT.
orders_capacity.quote: Our existing NPK-DAP capacity is 330,000 MT, and we have added another 165,000 MT, taking the total capacity to 495,000 MT.

orders_capacity.claim: Sales volumes in Q1 stood at 53,500 MT for NPK-DAP, 36,300 MT for SSP, and 21,000 MT for trading.
orders_capacity.quote: For NPK-DAP, it was 53,500 MT, for SSP 36,300 MT

orders_capacity.claim: The company has an installed capacity of 6.15 Lakh MTPA.
Fertilizer production reached 94,103 MT for the quarter driven by peak Rabi demand.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved fertilizer production of 94,103 MT, driven by peak Rabi season demand and improved operational throughput

orders_capacity.claim: Total annual production for FY26 reached 397,263 MT.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved total production of 397,263 MT, supported by High demand across markets

orders_capacity.claim: NPK/DAP and SSP plants operated above rated capacity during the year.
orders_capacity.quote: Record high utilization levels in NPK/DAP and SSP plants operating above rated capacity, highlighting strong market acceptance and efficient asset utilization

capital_allocation.quote: Regarding collection of Rs. 700 crore. Because last quarter the debtors was around Rs. 300 crore. Collection is more than Rs. 700 crore.

capital_allocation.claim: The company completed a 5-for-1 stock split, reducing share face value from ₹10 to ₹2.
capital_allocation.quote: Recently, the company successfully executed a 5-for-1 stock split, subdividing the face value of our equity shares from ₹ 10 per share to ₹ 2 per share.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's strategic blueprint includes disciplined capital allocation as one of its five core pillars.
capital_allocation.quote: Our strategic blueprint rests on five core pillars: backward integration, capacity expansion, product diversification, disciplined capital allocation and deep farmer connect.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia created supply chain disruptions and raised procurement and freight costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia, particularly surrounding critical shipping lanes through the Strait of Hormuz, introduced considerable uncertainty across global industry, global fertilizer supply chains during the quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: By the end of June, a 40% rainfall deficit led to a 22.7% year-on-year decline in national Kharif sowing.
risks_headwinds.quote: By the end of June, cumulative rainfall was nearly 40% below normal, resulting in national Kharif sowing declining by 22.7% year-on-year to 182.7 lakh hectares, compared to 236.5 lakh hectares during the corresponding period last year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Commissioning of new capacity increased quarterly depreciation to ₹13 crore and finance costs to ₹20 crore.
risks_headwinds.quote: Depreciation increased from around ₹8.7 crore to ₹13 crore, while finance costs increased from around ₹13 crore to ₹20 crore.

risks_headwinds.claim: Factors that could cause actual results to differ materially include market conditions, regulatory changes, competitive pressures, and technological advancements.
risks_headwinds.quote: Factors that could cause actual results to differ materially include market conditions, regulatory changes, competitive pressures, and technological advancements.

risks_headwinds.claim: The fertilizer industry relies on imports for approximately 90% of key intermediates.
risks_headwinds.quote: Given the industry's reliance on imports for ~90% of key intermediates, these global movements had a direct impact on cost structure.

risks_headwinds.claim: Input cost volatility and global supply uncertainties remain key monitorable for the industry.
risks_headwinds.quote: On the other hand, input cost volatility and global supply uncertainties remain key monitorable.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets an additional 30%–35% turnover growth over last year.
management_commitments.quote: We are hoping that over the remaining quarters, we will be able to smoothen our production, and we will be able to achieve an additional 30%–35% turnover over last year.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to maintain a quarterly revenue run-rate of over ₹500 crore across the remaining quarters of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

management_commitments.quote: And this capacity will start in FY29 after 2 years.

management_commitments.quote: As part of our long-term sustainability strategy, Krishana Phoschem has entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement (GASA) under India’s National Green Hydrogen Mission for 70,000 MTPA.

management_commitments.quote: With enhanced capacities now operational, we expect the benefits of this expansion to meaningfully reflect in our performance from FY27 onwards, supported by improved scale, operating leverage, and better efficiency levels.
